name: Otta-Walla
address: 20 El Paso Blvd, Green Mountain Falls, CO 80819
short_description: Historic 4-bedroom home with wraparound deck overlooking a bubbling creek, rich in Green Mountain Falls history.
full_description:
Otta-Walla cabin is full of family fun and history. This three-bedroom, two bath home has a fully-equipped kitchen, sleeping loft (in addition to the bedrooms), sun room, and a wraparound deck that overlooks a bubbling creek on the property. A cathedral ceiling provides an airiness to the living room. The house sits on the site of the first, 1-room Otta-Walla, built in the late 1800's by one of the first vacationing families of Green Mountain Falls.

The cabin is a few minutes level walk from the village's center and the iconic Victorian gazebo located in the middle of the lake. Kids of all ages love to fish, picnic, and enjoy the playground. In the town center, you will find two popular restaurants and the Blue Moose bar.

GMF has miles of well-maintained trails around it, including the road where Otta-Walla sits. Santa's Workshop (a vintage amusement park) is down the road from GMF in Cascade. Fun-loving Manitou Springs is just 15 minutes down Ute Pass (Highway 24) with its arcade, its shops and art galleries. Manitou's next door neighbor, Colorado Springs, is home to the Garden of the Gods, Seven Falls, Cheyenne Mountain Zoo, the Broadmoor Hotel and the United States Air Force Academy.

Five minutes north of GMF on Highway 24 is Woodland Park. Save yourself a trip to the Springs: in Woodland you can buy groceries, gas up the car, obtain fishing licenses, buy liquor, visit a hospital or vet clinic. Check out the restaurants and shopping. The weekly Farmers/Crafters Market is held every Friday from 7am-1pm.

For the day-trippers, the historic mining towns of Cripple Creek and Victor are close by and the scenery going up the mountains is breathtaking. Cripple Creek also boasts casinos. There's great fishing and luscious scenery at 11-Mile Canyon Reservoir (45 minutes west) and Deckers (38 minutes north of Woodland Park). Breckenridge is about a two-hour drive from Otta-Walla. On the way, you will go through Wilkerson Pass and South Park where you may spot buffalo and antelope.

Home is professionally managed by a local company.
